title: Computed W33 Graph Sector Evidence Compiler

operator_core.computed_support: G2 channels align with state/closed-even invariants; G channels align with transition/open-turn invariants

minimal_bridge.computed_support: mass/gap are spectral readouts; heat/zeta are even scalar functional traces; spinor/resolvent are first-order transition kernels

transform_class.computed_support: separates algebraic readouts, exponential kernels, Green resolvent, and zeta transform

architecture_upgrade: CCCLI derived larger W33 sector maps from structural motifs. CCCLII constructs W(3,3) directly and computes graph evidence supporting the state/transition, closed/open-turn, and local-line/transport sector hypotheses.
theorem: The W33 graph constructed from GF(3)^4 symplectic projective points has SRG(40,12,2,4), 240 edges, 160 triangles, 40 isotropic K4 lines, and a uniform non-backtracking turn split 2+9=11. These computed invariants provide graph-derived evidence for sector maps separating state or even channels from transition or first-order channels.
honesty_boundary: The compiler derives graph evidence for sector maps. It still does not prove that a particular sector map is the physically realized one without response data or additional representation constraints.
